item.title: Pandemic-Honed Performers Broke Out In 2025
item.description: Stuck at home in the early years of the pandemic, New Haven's budding musicians turned boredom into bangers, making their virtual mark on an uncertain future. In 2025, this new generation of artists unafraid to hit "record" brought their homebrewed skills to New Haven's public stages. item.title: 96 Apartments Approved For Suburb-City Border
item.description: After a year of debate, Woodbridge zoning commissioners voted to allow 96 new apartments to be built on the town's border with New Haven -- a project that has incited so much controversy that the suburb might amend its zoning rules to prohibit similar projects moving forward. The post 96 Apartments Approved For Suburb-City Border appeared first on New Haven Independent.
